title: Marked classification
label: thm:markedclass

title: Complete homomorphism description
label: thm:allhom
evidence: Written proof in preserved monograph; new Lean coverage is specified separately by lean_status and scope_note.
scope_note: Every actual additive homomorphism is proved diagonal without continuity or diagonal hypotheses. The exact converse, finite-defect condition, automatic continuity, and its full-completion coordinate action are checked. The diagonal formula holds for all rational preimages H_W, not only paired selector groups.

title: Torsion-image obstruction
label: thm:homobstruction
evidence: Written proof in preserved monograph; new Lean coverage is specified separately by lean_status and scope_note.
scope_note: Arbitrary additive homomorphisms, with no continuity or diagonality hypothesis, have torsion image when selectors disagree infinitely. Every map factors uniquely through the actual D, and injective or surjective maps exist exactly at finite disagreement. A nonzero coordinate map is proved in the positive suite, guarding against a false zero-image conclusion.

title: Endomorphism ring
label: thm:endGA
evidence: Written proof in preserved monograph; new Lean coverage is specified separately by lean_status and scope_note.
scope_note: The actual endomorphism ring is identified as the admissible diagonal subring, with the eventual-rational selected-coordinate characterization. Infinite selector support makes the rational quotient scalar unique. Ring laws, surjectivity and the exact zero-scalar kernel are proved. Denominator primes remain in the permitted finite exceptional set. The chosen lifts are not claimed to form a homomorphic section.

title: Automorphisms
label: thm:autGA
evidence: Written proof in preserved monograph; new Lean coverage is specified separately by lean_status and scope_note.
scope_note: The automorphism criterion requires every prime-coordinate scalar to be nonzero. The inverse multiplier is proved to preserve the original rank-one groups, the quotient scalar is proved nonzero, and the actual inverse formula is checked. Product invertibility is not assumed to imply invertibility on arbitrary rational-subspace preimages.

title: Seed-rank separation
label: thm:rankGA
evidence: Written proof in preserved monograph; new Lean coverage is specified separately by lean_status and scope_note.
scope_note: For every binary selector: exact algebraic full-endomorphism rank aleph_0, no finite topological operator family, and exact ordinary topological rank aleph_0 in the original group. The actual canonical completion has a named topological generator and ordinary topological rank one. These contracts are defined separately and proved together in the final bundled theorem.
